img.caption: Fig 3: Calibration quality and refusal behavior. Left: Expected Calibration Error (15-bin, lower is better); right: intra-domain false-reject rate. SetFit+MC is poorly calibrated on CLINC150 (ECE 0.695); TECP-14B and QP-10-shot are either over-confident (ECE 0.47 on MixATIS) or over-refuse (QP rejects 86% of in-domain CLINC150). Ours attains the lowest ECE on CLINC150 (0.005) and MixSNIPS (0.045) while keeping false refusal within 4.6-20.8%.
